title: Assassination Classroom
source: Assassination Classroom manga by Yusei Matsui (180 chapters), including the epilogue seven years later.
world: A yellow octopus-like creature destroys most of the Moon and threatens to destroy Earth in a year, unless the students of the outcast Class 3-E at Kunugigaoka Junior High assassinate him. He becomes their homeroom teacher, Koro-sensei, and the best teacher they ever had. The class trains as assassins while growing as people. Comedy, action and a heartfelt goodbye.
power_system: No powers. Koro-sensei moves at Mach 20; only special anti-sensei knives and BB pellets harm him.
